name: US Annual Live Births
citation: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, NCHS. "Natality Measures for Females by Race and Hispanic Origin: United States." data.cdc.gov/resource/89yk-m38d. Accessed 15 July 2026.
license: U.S. federal public data (CDC NCHS natality; FRED/Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis). Free to use and redistribute.
description:
Annual U.S. live births (all races), 1960-2018, with annual macro covariates. Application: OB/maternity-ward and K-12 school-capacity planning. Covariate glossary:
- live births: total U.S. live births per year, NCHS natality measures (89yk-m38d).
- us unemployment rate annual: annual-mean U.S. unemployment rate, percent (FRED UNRATE).
- us house price index: annual-mean Case-Shiller U.S. National Home Price Index, Jan-2000=100 (FRED CSUSHPINSA); back-filled constant pre-1987 (series start).
preprocessing: 1. Pulled target from the cited open-data API (Socrata/CDC).
2. Aligned FRED macro covariates (UNRATE, CSUSHPINSA) onto the target's annual time index by calendar-year mean.
3. Back-filled the Case-Shiller index with a constant prior to 1987 (series start); births are annual and required no aggregation.
4. Forward/back-filled sparse covariate gaps; dropped provisional/partial tail periods.
5. Single shared ISO-8601 time index; no calendar columns.
